name: Kochou Miyabi
source:
A rich ojousama from the tennis club. Her tennis skill is top-notch, to the point that she can get high ranks even on a national match. Both boys and girls idolized her but boys feel it is hard to approach her.

"Recently, my body condition is bad. Can't seem to focus on tennis."
